summary: Idaho County lookout: 1929 L-4 cabin on Clearwater NF, destroyed 1956; no source describes what remains at the site.

facts.design: L-4 cabin (Forest Service list says only cabin)
facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1956; no source describes what remains at the site.

events.note: Cabin, called an L-4 cabin by two sources; about 7 miles WSW of Powell Ranger Station

evidence.supports: about seven miles west-southwest of Powell Ranger Station
Forest Service list gives only the word cabin

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts call the 1929 building an L-4 cabin; the Forest Service list and the Forest Lookouts list give only cabin. The story uses the L-4 description with the Forest Service wording noted.

sources.title: Hot Springs Point Fire Lookout Cabin

corrections.why: The record holds the state name. firelookout.com gives Idaho County, Idaho.

notes_for_editor: Location conflict is unresolved: the FFLA list gives 46.47004, -114.83953, while the Idaho Fire Lookouts map pin (from its category page data) is about 760 m away at 46.4768643, -114.839558. The story gives no coordinates; check before publishing a map pin. Elevation: the Forest Service list gives 5,535 ft (cite 3, the only source with a figure); firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts leave it blank or unknown. The story attributes it to the Forest Service list, and facts.elevation_ft records it. Staffing: no staffing source found.
